---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem in SEQ
---

## What happened?

Describe the expected and observed behavior and give the shortest steps to reproduce it.

## Where did it happen?

Name the component (Studio, website/manual, desktop, firmware, or device tools). Include the app version or commit, OS, and browser if relevant. For device bugs, include the board model and variant, firmware version or build ID, and whether the device was connected.

Use a synthetic example or a redacted excerpt. Remove device serial numbers, private MIDI port names, and credentials from screenshots and logs. Keep backups and flash history private.
